name: R_HEALTHCARE_PHI_MRN_ACCT_DOB
description: Inline Web DLP: PHI presence (E_HEALTHCARE_PHI) or bulk export (E_PHI_BULK_EXPORT). Monitor-only to start; OCR on so screenshots and scanned PDFs are inspected; 10 KB floor suppresses small-telemetry false positives. Move to BLOCK after tuning.

name: R_HEALTHCARE_PHI_MRN_ACCT_DOB [Endpoint]
description: Endpoint DLP: the same detection as the inline rule "R_HEALTHCARE_PHI_MRN_ACCT_DOB" (E_HEALTHCARE_PHI, E_PHI_BULK_EXPORT). Monitor-only; enable after reviewing incidents.

name: R_HEALTHCARE_PHI_MRN_ACCT_DOB [SaaS]
description: SaaS Security API: the same detection as the inline rule "R_HEALTHCARE_PHI_MRN_ACCT_DOB" (E_HEALTHCARE_PHI, E_PHI_BULK_EXPORT). Monitor-only; enable after reviewing incidents.

name: R_HEALTHCARE_PHI_MRN_ACCT_DOB [Email]
description: Email DLP: the same detection as the inline rule "R_HEALTHCARE_PHI_MRN_ACCT_DOB" (E_HEALTHCARE_PHI, E_PHI_BULK_EXPORT). Monitor-only; enable after reviewing incidents.

name: E_HEALTHCARE_PHI [Endpoint Removable Media]
description: Endpoint DLP: E_HEALTHCARE_PHI on removable media (USB and other removable drives). One rule per engine so incidents name the engine. Monitor-only; enable after reviewing incidents.

name: E_PHI_BULK_EXPORT [Endpoint Removable Media]
description: Endpoint DLP: E_PHI_BULK_EXPORT on removable media (USB and other removable drives). One rule per engine so incidents name the engine. Monitor-only; enable after reviewing incidents.
